Liam O'Connor: Quick announce: rolling out a preview for 'retention-segmentation' in Private (VPC/on-prem) — gives customers per-tenant retention policies for control-plane telemetry, audit bundles, and cached model artifacts.
Liam O'Connor: Motivation: customers want precise retention controls to meet diverse regulatory needs (data minimization, regional retention, and short-lived caches).
Priya Desai: What it does: you can set separate retention windows and export/auto-purge policies for: control-plane logs, telemetry metrics, audit bundles, model cache blobs, and agent diagnostic dumps. Also supports region-tagged retention (e.g., EU-only retention).
Liam O'Connor: Rollout plan: canary in pk-staging-2 this afternoon, limited preview next week to invited customers, GA after legal/compliance sign-off (~4-8 weeks).
Liam O'Connor: Example CLI to set a retention policy:
```
redwoodctl private retention set --tenant t-321 \\
  --policy \"{\"logs\":\"30d\",\"audit_bundles\":\"365d\",\"model_cache\":\"7d\",\"region:eu\":{\"logs\":\"90d\"}}\"
redwoodctl private retention status --tenant t-321
```
Priya Desai: Export options: customers can opt to auto-export audit bundles before purge to S3/GCS/Azure or to a customer-managed vault. When export is enabled, purge only removes the local copy after successful export.
Legal: Note: customers who opt into Redwood-managed long-term retention for audit bundles must sign the "Retention Segmentation Addendum". If customers self-manage exports inside their VPC, no addendum required.
SRE: Emergency purge/unpurge flow: admins can trigger an immediate purge; unpurge (restore) is only possible if an exported copy exists. All purge/unpurge events are recorded in the tenant audit log and included in the retention audit bundle.
Liam O'Connor: Implementation detail: retention enforcement runs as a background sweep with idempotent deletes; for air-gapped installs we support local-only sweeps and an offline confirmation token so customers can schedule purges without outbound connectivity.
Priya Desai: UI: Console preview will have a Retention page per tenant showing active policies, next scheduled purge, and export status. Customers asked for a "simulate purge" button — we added a preview-only simulation that shows items that would be purged.
Legal: Sales guidance: do not promise cross-region retention replication until addendum finalized. Also flag customers with export-to-third-party requirements; they may need extra DPA language.
SRE: Canaries will validate that the purge job never removes items marked as immutable (immutable-config windows). Add a safety check to the sweeper.
Product Ops: Preview invites + addendum link scheduled to send tomorrow 09:00 PT. If you want to be on the preview roster, ping @Product Ops.
Oncall Bot: DeployBot: canary rollout started pk-staging-2 at 2026-03-30T14:02:11Z — job id db-8331.
Liam O'Connor: Please test with anonymized customer datasets and report edge cases under label private-retention-preview. Key areas to test: interop with KMS-backed exports, agent diag dump retention, and region-tag filters.
Priya Desai: Thanks — will follow up with the runbook and a short demo video.
